summary: Norrath is a world shaped by divine creation, mortal conflict, planar influence, and ancient civilizations whose legacies define its continents and cultures.

creation.origin: Forged by the gods during the Age of Creation.
creation.notes: Each deity contributed to the shaping of Norrath’s lands, races, and ecosystems.

ages.name: Age of Creation
ages.description: The gods forged Norrath and seeded its earliest life.

ages.name: Age of Scale
ages.description: Veeshan marked Norrath, beginning the reign of dragons.

ages.name: Age of Giants
ages.description: Rallos Zek’s creations dominated the world.

ages.name: Age of Elders
ages.description: Elves, dwarves, and other elder races rose to prominence.

ages.name: Age of Turmoil
ages.description: The modern era of conflict, exploration, and planar upheaval.

continents.antonica: A vast land of human kingdoms, deserts, forests, and ancient ruins.
continents.faydwer: A continent of elven forests, dwarven mountains, and gnomish innovation.
continents.odus: A land of arcane mastery, home to Erudites and deep magical secrets.
continents.kunark: A primal continent ruled by the Iksar legacy and ancient sarnak empires.
continents.velious: A frozen land of giants, dragons, and ancient conflicts.
continents.luclin: Norrath’s moon, divided between light and shadow, home to arcane mysteries.
